name: modex-monorepo
description: Modex — an open, Codex-App-style desktop coding agent (plus a CLI) built on a shared TypeScript agent engine.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @modex/core && npm run build -w modex && npm run build -w @modex/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @modex/core && npm run test -w @modex/desktop
